_comment: EXAMPLE claude.ai LIVE-connector manifest for core/surface_census.py. claude.ai remote connectors (mcp__claude_ai_*) are session-runtime tools injected server-side by the claude.ai web app; Claude Code NEVER persists them to any config file (grep -c mcp__claude_ai_ ~/.claude.json = 0), so a pure-code census cannot see them. This manifest is the authoritative LIVE source the census reads. Copy it to the stable default path ~/.claude/mcp-manager/claude_ai_connectors.json (or point --manifest at any copy), then keep it fresh with the one-line refresh step below. When the manifest is absent the census falls back to ~/.claude.json:claudeAiMcpEverConnected (an 'ever-connected' SUPERSET) labeled 'ever-fallback(overcount)' — never a silent zero.
_refresh: In any agent session: list the distinct mcp__claude_ai_* tool namespaces in your current tool inventory and overwrite the 'connectors' array below (with today's date + the session id). The census stays pure code; only this periodic manifest refresh is model-in-the-loop.
source: agent runtime tool inventory (distinct mcp__claude_ai_* namespaces)
